reaction: The result fits the goal, though it gives no further explanation yet.

effect: The mats trapped sediment and built stromatolites, completing the shore goal and showing how microbial activity can leave evidence in the landscape.
reaction: It was satisfying to see a small-scale process build a lasting structure.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making stromatolites was most worthwhile: it connected microbial layers, sediment trapping and evidence of ancient life.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making microbial mats was comparatively flat: the result named them but offered no explanation until the next combination.

surprise.text: I expected light to produce light-using cells, but it instead caused heritable variation; sunlight produced photosynthetic cells afterward.

arbitrary.text: The distinction between combining cells with Light and with Sun felt somewhat arbitrary before the results explained their different roles.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue: the chapter combined an engaging progression with useful explanations and was candid about the unresolved origin of life.
